body.prompt: Locked-off camera with a very slow, subtle push-in. He is talking: his right hand loosely holding the pen rises and makes relaxed explaining gestures in the air, opening and turning slightly, then lowers; left hand rests on the desk. Keep the exact same man, navy two-piece suit, white shirt, wide dark silk tie, white pocket square, watch, microphone and library background as the reference image. Black and white, soft film grain, warm light from above. The framing stays at or below the shirt collar the whole time: never tilt up, never show the chin, jaw, mouth or face. He never writes; the notebook stays untouched. Calm, natural movement. No text, no logos.
